facts.business: Koiya International Limited (formerly Popees Cares Limited) is engaged in textiles, fibres & readymade garments trading, information technology & software services, and internet service provider operations, though it recorded nil revenue from operations in FY 2025-26.

auditor.name: M/s. Mahesh C. Solanki & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Market Risk – exposure to price fluctuations in textile raw materials and demand cyclicality
Credit Risk – exposure to counterparties in trading and lending/deposit-related activities
Liquidity Risk – current liabilities of Rs. 12,287.67 thousand exceeded current assets of Rs. 2,593.09 thousand as at 31st March 2026, resulting in a current ratio of 0.21

Net Worth / Going Concern Risk – accumulated losses of Rs. 70,039.59 thousand have eroded paid-up equity share capital, resulting in negative net worth of Rs. (9,597.09) thousand as at 31st March 2026
Foreign Exchange Risk – arising from cross-border import/export and software services rendered abroad
Regulatory Risk – compliance with Companies Act, 2013, FEMA/Foreign Exchange Regulations, and telecom/ISP licensing conditions
Technology and Cybersecurity Risk – relevant to software, data processing and ISP-related activities
facts.related_party_note: Company continues to be dependent on funding support from the Managing Director in the absence of significant operating revenue.
